{{Top}}
[[File:SandtrooperBackpack-ANH.png|thumb|right|250px|A desert sandtrooper wearing an SD-48 survival backpack in Mos Eisley]]
The '''SD-48 survival backpack''' was used by [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|desert stormtroopers]] of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], allowing them to complete extended missions within the unrelenting heat of the hot, dry [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] they were deployed to.<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> The [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] was [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] standard-issue carrying full survival and encampment equipment.<ref name="CCG-Backpack">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Stormtrooper Backpack}}</ref> Each SD-48 held several [[Liter/Legends|liters]] of purified [[Water/Legends|water]], along with a miniaturized [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaparator]]. Other equipment included a [[Long-range comlink/Legends|long-range comlink]], [[collapsible reflective shelter]],<ref name="IHB" /> [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], and ammunition.<ref name="CCG-Backpack" />
